items.author: Lorna Villaruz
items.body: PIN NUMBER RECEIVED!!! 🙏🙏🙏 Thank you Lord. After 2 years of papers, IELTS, CBT, OSCE, waiting waiting waiting... I am now officially a registered nurse in the UK. Next stop Liverpool!!! Thank you to my family and to everyone who prayed for me. Special thanks to my sister from another mother, you know who you are 😘

items.author: Lorna Villaruz
items.title: Lorna Villaruz
items.body: Charing!!! Did you see?? Agency says flight is 14 January, Dubai to Manchester, arrive around 1pm. I start on 25 January, Ward 7 medical at Mersey Bank Hospital, induction first then the preceptorship. Are you sure ok I stay with you first month? I will bring dried mangoes and the Bicol pili for Tito Ben haha. I still cannot believe it, 20 years you have been telling me to come.

items.author: Lorna Villaruz
items.title: Lorna Villaruz
items.body: Also please dont say anything on FB about my OSCE resit ha. Only you know I failed the medication station in August. And the agency loan is still £6,800 I have to pay back from my salary, Rommel doesnt want our families to know. Just between us 🙏
